meta.title: JEE test series in Pune | D-SAP Ghule Tutorials
meta.description: Chapter tests, weekly tests, monthly JEE Main mocks and quarterly JEE Advanced mocks, all on an online portal that works like the real JEE.

intro.text: Our students take tests on a fixed calendar, from a short test after each chapter to full JEE mocks. Every test is taken on our online portal, which works like the real JEE screen.

body.text: Each kind of test has its own job.

points.text: After every chapter: a test on that chapter.
Every week: a test that switches between one topic and the full syllabus so far.
Every fourth week: a longer test on everything covered.
Every month: a full JEE Main mock, {{fact:exam.jee-main#questions}} questions in {{fact:exam.jee-main#hours}} hours.
Every quarter in Class 12: a JEE Advanced mock.

body.text: Each test comes back with a personal analysis of how your child did.
Parents also meet the teachers at parent-teacher meetings.

questions.q: Are the mocks as long as the real JEE Main?

a.text: Yes: {{fact:exam.jee-main#questions}} questions in {{fact:exam.jee-main#hours}} hours, all compulsory.

questions.q: Can my child try a test first?
questions.a: Yes. The [home page](page:home) has a short test that works like the real screen.
